# 生天經頌解--王吉昌

**ID:** KR5a0325
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0325

## Authors / Editors
- 王吉昌

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-juan rhymed commentary by the Quánzhēn 全真 *nèidān* 內丹 master Wáng Jíchāng 王吉昌 (*hào* Chāorán zǐ 超然子, fl. 1220–1240) on the short Táng scripture *[Yuánshǐ tiānzūn shuō shēngtiān dédào jīng 元始天尊說生天得道經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0024)* (DZ 24, the parent scripture, also known as the *Shēngtiān jīng* 生天經 by abbreviation). Preserved in the *Zhèngtǒng Dàozàng* 正統道藏 (DZ 0313 / CT 313 = TC 313), 洞真部 讚頌類. The work comprises thirty-seven seven-character poems explaining and expanding upon the meaning of the parent scripture. The general tenor of the commentary is that of *nèidān* spiritual alchemy, in keeping with Wáng's other major Quánzhēn writing, the *[Huìzhēn jí 會真集 (DZ 247)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0248)*.

**Abstract**

Kristofer Schipper, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 2:1166 (§3.B.9, The Quánzhēn Order), describes the work as comprising thirty-seven poems explaining and expanding upon the meaning of the short Táng scripture *Yuánshǐ tiānzūn shuō shēngtiān dédào jīng*. The general tenor of the commentary is that of spiritual alchemy, in keeping with the teachings of Wáng — the author of the related Quánzhēn anthology *[Huìzhēn jí 會真集 (DZ 247)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0248)*. Wáng Jíchāng's period of activity is fixed by the stele inscriptions of two of his disciples, preserved in *[DZ 973 Gānshuǐ xiānyuán lù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0973)* 6.22a and 8.26a, and by the date of the *Qǐzhēn jí* 啟真集 ([KR5a0249](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0249) / DZ 248) anthology of his disciple Liú Zhìyuán 劉志淵 (1186–1244). The frontmatter accordingly brackets composition to Wáng's mature period of teaching activity in the early thirteenth century, ca. 1220–1244.
